comment: Single source of truth for the vhl-bridge line protocol. Consumed by TS (packages/host/highlight/src/protocol.ts, imported directly) and by Python (engine/vhl_bridge.py, which reads this file through engine/contract.py) so the two sides cannot drift. INDEX SEMANTICS: request/response arrays list PAYLOAD columns only, so index i means the (i+1)-th tab-separated field on the wire — field 0 is always the framing token ('<verb>' for hello/ping, 'ok' for ok-framed replies). Every payload column is single-line: JSON is emitted compact and any tab/newline inside a plain string is folded to a space. Framing: 'verb' = reply starts with the verb token (hello/ping), 'ok' = reply starts with 'ok'. A refusal is always 'err\t<CODE>\t<message>'.

options.comment: The knob table for analyze.start's optionsJson. Declared HERE rather than duplicated in the bridge and the host: a knob the host validates but the engine does not implement (or the reverse) is a silent lie. field = HighlightConfig attribute; type is the coercion; min/max/enum are enforced on BOTH sides; requires names the capability (a models.list key) that an EXPLICIT opt-in needs — defaults may degrade silently, explicit requests may not; special = handled by the bridge itself and never passed to HighlightConfig; group is a UI section hint.

whisperModelPath.comment: Local CTranslate2 model directory (fine-tune output, docs/FINETUNE.zh.md C2); overrides whisperModelSize when set. Bridge-handled like srtPath: validated at job creation, never passed to HighlightConfig — a hub size name belongs in whisperModelSize, an absolute path belongs here (faster-whisper's first arg is size_or_path).

onnxModelFormat.comment: Output layout the engine decodes: yolox = raw head [N,5+nc] fed RAW 0-255 pixels (grid decode strides 8/16/32, engine-side); rtdetr = [num_queries,4+nc] normalized cxcywh + logits fed 0-1. The ONNX export must match — see docs/FINETUNE.zh.md A4/A5 (check_layout.py).

onnxIouThreshold.comment: Per-class greedy NMS IoU inside the engine's detector.

clipModelName.comment: OpenCLIP architecture id (first arg of open_clip.create_model_and_transforms); any arch the installed open-clip-torch knows, must stay consistent with clipPretrained.

clipPretrained.comment: OpenCLIP checkpoint: a hub tag OR a local state_dict path (fine-tune output, docs/FINETUNE.zh.md B2/B3). A bad arch/tag/path fails the task with the loader's own error — explicit opt-in fails loudly, it is not silently 0.

contentPreset.comment: Weight profile per video type; presets are heuristic starting points, not learned. 'auto' classifies content via OpenCLIP and so needs the clip capability (enforced host-side and bridge-side, since the generic requires is per-option not per-value); the other values are pure weight vectors needing no model. An explicit weights choice overrides any preset.

adaptiveWeights.comment: Down-weight signals that are near-constant on THIS video so they cannot mask discriminative ones (e.g. object saliency saturated at 1.0). Pure selection improvement; set false to compare against the raw recipe. The report records the effective weights and per-signal activity.
